item.text: {"brief_complete":false,"completion_reason":"Material scope boundaries remain around deployment, compatibility, and multi-user operation.","questions":[{"decision_key":"v1_deployment_boundary","label":"Deployment boundary","context":"The deployment target changes host access, service controls, and security scope.","question":"What deployment boundary must v1 support?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"One self-hosted web app, optionally reachable on trusted LAN"},{"number":2,"text":"Localhost-only single-machine app"},{"number":3,"text":"Internet-accessible hosted service"},{"number":4,"text":"Packaged desktop application"}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":92},{"decision_key":"existing_state_compatibility","label":"State compatibility","context":"Compatibility determines migration work and whether current records remain usable.","question":"What existing NexusCentral state must v1 preserve?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Import essential conversations, configurations, and run evidence"},{"number":2,"text":"Preserve configurations only"},{"number":3,"text":"Preserve all existing state and behavior"},{"number":4,"text":"Start clean with no migration"}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":88},{"decision_key":"multi_user_v1_scope","label":"Multi-user scope","context":"Multi-user operation adds identity, permissions, ownership, and concurrency requirements.","question":"Is multi-user collaboration part of v1?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"No; single trusted operator only"},{"number":2,"text":"Yes; trusted operators share one workspace"},{"number":3,"text":"Yes; separate users need roles and private work"}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":82}]}
